name: Asker- Kraakholmen Landing
notes: Good landing skills required for landing on the small island. Lifejackets required and are lent out. Several alternative landing areas on the mainland. No problem!

name: Nicostarten Landing
notes:
The regular landing is on the field to the left of the takeoff. It is not visible from the takeoff, but will come in view just a few meters out in the air. The field has a tractor path in the middle of it. 

Landing should only happen on the tractor path, and packing must be done on the path.

Please contact the local club for more information on which field it is if in doubt.

Walk down the road towards the farm, turn right up the field and walk towards the radio antenna. Close the gate! Follow the path. The takeoff is behind the radio antenna to the right.

name: Berge Landing
notes: On field below takeoff. Make sure you know the right field before takeoff.

name: Lensamansstarten Landing
notes: The landing is the football field in Ã…rdal. Make sure it isn't in use before going up. Hanggliders have other fields they land on, please contact the local club for more information

name: Nuten Landing
notes: Landing on the field below start, in front of the houses. The houses will create some turbulence.

name: Kløve - Øvre Eidfjord Landing
notes: By the camping.

name: Hjelle Landing
notes:
Next to the lake. 
Watch out for the power lines crossing the field.

name: Bjellandsfjellet Landing
notes: There is a marked trail (red streamers) up the mountain. One must go, and the trip takes about 35-40 minutes. Landing is down at the slaughterhouse. If you need more space for landing, you can land outside the landing area on one of the outlying fields.

name: Dalsnuten Landing
notes:
The landing is at Dale, or by water along the trail on the way up.

Picture shows Dalsnuten on the left, landing is in the corner field at the bottom of ridge (end of the fields by the buildings, you can just see gravel car park to the right of the end field amongst the trees) - note that the Dale area is being developet so check area before flying.

name: Sauebeite
notes: Landing må avklares med grunneier på forhånd

name: Kvåle Stadion
notes: Vær oppmerksom på aktivitet på banen

name: Main landing
notes: Det er etablert landing i Loen, se bilde. Bruk området som er merket "Hovedlanding". Bufferområde merket "Reserve-/nødlanding" brukes dersom nødvendig. I vekstsesongen er det viktig å unngå unødvendig tråkk i enga, ta med utstyret til veikanten for pakking. Biler skal parkeres på det oppmerkede området, bruk parkeringsplasser lenger vest dersom behov for flere plasser. Vindpølse er montert på "Hovedlanding", i tillegg er det vanligvis flagg i området ved Hotel Alexandra og Hotel Loenfjord. Var observant på flaggene i dalen, och räkna med en god del sjunk i luften ifall de står ens lite från berget.

name: Bjørndalen
notes: Landing zones are almost everywhere on a nearby bog. If landing at Bleik please land on the beach or on the fields. DO NOT LAND ON THE GOLF COURSE OR NEARBY THE GRAVEYARD.

name: Umskardet

name: Rana, Snøfjellet Landing

name: Rana Kubben Landing

name: Rana, Mofjellet Vest landing

name: Arnipa Landing
notes: Landing can be done on all the bogs and fields, but stay away from the cabins in the area. The locals are maintaining the road out to the mountain so we don't want to disturb them. Also be aware of sheep and wet landings...
